title: campanula rotundifolia subsp. romanica
intro: Campanula rotundifolia subsp. romanica, commonly known as Roman Bellflower, is a plant species in the Campanulaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Roman Bellflower are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit various pharmacological activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Roman Bellflower on human health, but its traditional use suggests its potential as a natural remedy for various ailments.
